learning_outcomes.text: Explain what embeddings are and how vector similarity enables semantic search
Choose an embedding model and distance metric appropriate to a task
Describe how vector indexes (e.g. approximate nearest neighbour) trade recall for speed
Model data, metadata and namespaces in a vector store for filtering and multi-tenancy
Operate a vector store: upserts, re-embedding, and keeping an index in sync with source data
Reason about cost, dimensionality and scaling of a vector search system

integrative_case: A SaaS company adds semantic search across each customer's private documents: pick an embedding model and distance metric, choose an index that meets a latency target, model metadata and namespaces so tenants are isolated, and plan how the index stays in sync as documents change.
